newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end slightly lower on profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end slightly lower on profit taking.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended slightly lower on Wednesday, weighed down by profit-taking pressure ahead of corporate book closings at the end of March.
The market was briefly nervous after a series of statements in the telecommunications sector, but the impact was limited.
The Nikkei 225 average closed down 85.45 points or 0.46 percent at 18,183.27. Its March futures were down 80 points to end at 18,130 and June 130 points at 18,050.
